Installation required?

Frequently asked

Useful answers,
before we begin.

Still deciding what you need? Start with a conversation and we’ll help shape the brief.

Contact our team →
Do you provide furniture for complete office setups?+

Yes. We can support individual items, phased requirements, or coordinated furniture for a complete new office.

Can you help plan the furniture layout?+

Yes. We can recommend practical arrangements based on space, headcount, workflow, and furniture requirements.

Is installation included?+

Installation can be included in your quotation based on the products, location, and project scope.

Do you deliver outside the local city?+

Delivery coverage depends on your location and order size. Share the site address for a tailored response.

Can I order furniture in bulk?+

Yes. We support business and institutional bulk requirements with quantity-based quotations.

Can products be customised?+

Selected products may offer size, finish, upholstery, storage, and configuration options.

Is warranty support available?+

Warranty terms vary by product. Applicable coverage will be shown clearly in your quotation.

How can I request a quotation?+

Complete the enquiry form, call, email, or use WhatsApp once your verified contact details are added.
